sampling_design: three independent ABBA blocks; A=reference and B=immutable candidate Episode 7; deterministic A-B-B-A order
rank_aggregation: max rank completion latency per iteration
primary_estimator: arithmetic mean latency; paired block speedup from candidate/reference means
outlier_policy: classify but do not delete slow valid samples
uncertainty_method: paired block bootstrap with deterministic seed 1515 and 10000 resamples
hash_definition: SHA256 of this serialization with hash value PENDING_STATISTICAL_POLICY_HASH
